Supporting Career Paths
Health Sciences

Headed intonursing or health care?We help pay for it.

The JCD Foundation helps pay tuition, room and board, books and supplies for Fox Valley students starting careers in health sciences. Tell us what you want to do and what it costs to get there.

Registered nurse · Radiology tech · Dental hygiene · Phlebotomy · Lab tech
Who can apply
Students at 13 Fox Valley high schools, homeschoolers, and students already in a program.
What we fund
Up to 50% of tuition, room and board, books and supplies, paid to your school. No fee to apply.
When
Apply Dec 1, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027. Hear back by March 31.
